members.title: Our story
members.body: An adventure born from a simple idea: to create a warm place where good food and good moments are shared. Every day we welcome you with the same passion.

members.title: In the kitchen
members.body: Behind the stove, homemade cooking inspired by seasonal produce and the recipes closest to our hearts.

members.title: In the dining room
members.body: Attentive, smiling service to guide you and turn your meal into a special moment.

reservation.afterSentMessage: Thank you for your reservation request! A confirmation email will be sent to you shortly. Please check your inbox.
reservation.spamWarning: Be sure to check your spam / junk folder — our confirmation email sometimes ends up there.

reservation.pickDateFirst: Select a date first to see available time slots.
reservation.slotUnavailable: This slot has just filled up. Please choose another time.
